title: 두 문단의 첫 단어 제한 보완

scenes.title: runtime-texture-size
lines: The asset exposes virtual dimensions and tile settings. Distinguish the addressable extent from the resident contents. A large address range does not mean every texel is simultaneously resident. Addressing data also needs storage, so budget addresses and contents separately.

scenes.title: geometry-car-material
lines: The car’s surface appearance changes. Keep the body and wheel as references while separating shape from material appearance.
